# Ayush Kashyap — Senior Software Engineer · Healthtech

> Ayush Kashyap builds and operates production healthcare software at scale. For ~4 years he has
> built and now operates a multi-tenant, white-label EHR platform end-to-end — and he is one of the
> principal contributors to the core platform (roughly a quarter of the codebase). It serves 2,000+
> active clinics, thousands of doctors, and hundreds of thousands of patients across 100+
> specialties, processing tens of thousands of appointments a month. Stack: TypeScript, Python,
> React, React Native, Node/Express, MySQL, Redis, Socket.io, AWS, FHIR R4/HL7. Open to senior
> engineering roles — remote or Australia relocation.

## Highlights
- Architected and operate a multi-tenant healthtech EHR platform: one codebase serving 2,000+ active clinics, thousands of doctors, and hundreds of thousands of patients across 100+ specialties, with per-tenant isolation and a white-label layer of dozens of custom-branded deployments — no per-client forks.
- Implemented FHIR R4 / HL7 interoperability for a national digital-health programme.
- Built an in-house clinical AI & speech stack (Python): an AI medical scribe, speech-model fine-tuning, and speech-to-text.
- Shipped clinician + patient apps (React Native) live on the App Store & Play Store — Hermes, Fastlane, OTA updates.
- Tech lead: GitHub org consolidation, deployment pipeline, a cloud cost-optimization initiative, and a major React Native version migration.
- Built Letsdrive solo over ~2 years — a carpooling + peer-to-peer car-rental marketplace across three codebases (Flutter mobile, TypeScript/Express/Prisma backend with a 13-model schema, Next.js admin).
